frequency_question: What proportion of major executive-branch submitted international nuclear/arms agreements face a successfully enacted joint resolution of disapproval within the statutory window?
membership_rule: Includes formal nuclear cooperation agreements (123 agreements) or major arms sales subject to congressional review with statutory deadlines for disapproval resolutions. Excludes informal understandings or non-statutory executive arrangements.
window: Statutory review periods (typically 30 to 90 continuous days, scaling up to the 287-day maximum horizon specified in the question).
